newsitem.title: USA: Sacramento, Calif., school bond fails narrowly.
newsitem.headline: Sacramento, Calif., school bond fails narrowly.

text.p: A $225 million Sacramento City Unified School District bond measure failed by just 260 votes, election officials said Tuesday.
Measure E, which would have authorized the bond issue to repair school facilities, had 66.4 percent of the vote, just short of the two-thirds required, according to the final election tally.
Sacramento County election officials said 61,478 voters backed the bond measure while 31,077 voted against it.
The bond measure, which appeared on the November 5 ballot, had until now been too close to call.
